About Us

Bridging technology and pastoralism

Mobile Vet is a technology-driven platform that leverages satellite intelligence, smart RFID-GPS ear tags, and SMS/USSD alerts to help pastoralist families in Ethiopia protect their animals and livelihoods before disaster strikes.

Our Mission

Ethiopia's livestock sector contributes 45% of agricultural GDP and supports millions of pastoralists. Yet recurring droughts, disease outbreaks, and a lack of digital records put these livelihoods at risk every year.

Mobile Vet was created to bridge the gap between advanced geospatial analytics and the realities of remote pastoralist life. We believe that every pastoralist family deserves access to the same predictive tools that industrial agriculture takes for granted.

By combining satellite intelligence, machine learning, and universal mobile technology, we create a digital safety net that protects animals, secures livelihoods, and opens doors to financial inclusion.

Our Values

What drives us

Pastoralist First

Every design decision starts with the realities of remote pastoralist life — low connectivity, basic phones, and illiteracy-friendly interfaces.

Prevention Over Cure

We believe stopping a disaster before it happens is more valuable than any response after the fact. Early warning saves lives and livelihoods.

Open & Accessible

Open standards, multilingual support, and universal accessibility via SMS/USSD ensure no one is left behind.

Community Led

Our pilots are designed with pastoralist communities, not for them. Local knowledge is the foundation of our predictions.

Data Driven

Satellite imagery, machine learning, and verified field data combine to create the most accurate livestock risk platform in East Africa.

Animal Welfare

Healthy animals mean healthy communities. Veterinary traceability and disease prevention are at the heart of everything we build.

Mobile Vet

Bridging technology and pastoralism to protect Ethiopia's livestock, livelihoods and future through data-driven innovation.
